sourceKind: Artist-authored graphical body, not scan, photo or calibrated anatomy

registration.torsoY: source pelvis + Q rowY/.6 * (source neck - source pelvis); source bbox-centered angular contour mapped to current garment radii
registration.leftRight: Left source sleeve contour mirrored for Q arm-0; no demographic/morph change
registration.shoulderRow9: Samples separated upper arm at source fraction .34, then blends .2 to fixed shoulder rows. Direct row9 source plane would include torso, not an isolated sleeve.

clothing: Q garment radii and folds define an authored ease envelope, independently of naked source. Bounded source angular factors modulate it. These differences are not measured fabric thickness. No underlying nude body is introduced.
unchanged: All bones/row Y/skin weights/head/neck/hands/materials. Torso first2+last row, sleeve first2+last2 position rows fixed. 483 vertices/816 triangles.
qualityBoundary: New numeric candidate; old unrecovered v42 is not acceptance evidence. No rendered cloth/seam/motion or PS4-quality pass.
